name: Existing Home Sales
consensus_source: Web search of news reports on the 2026-10-13 release (Trading Economics): consensus 3.95M, one other preview cited 3.96M. Not verified on the source pages.
read: Existing home sales rose 1.5% to 3.99M SAAR, about 0.04M above the 3.95M consensus. Closings lag, and 30-year rates near 7.4% point to weaker Oct and Nov prints. Mild support for builders and REITs, limited GDP lift.
